key.name: toggle
key.description: Shows, focuses or hides the quick terminal.

key.name: size
key.description: Percentage of the work area the terminal takes along the axis it drops from. Height for top and bottom, width for left and right, both for center.

key.name: ghostty-command
key.description: Program launched for the quick terminal.

key.name: extra-args
key.description: Additional command line arguments appended when launching Ghostty.
